proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved a six-diagram full BAP class of exact move width n−3 under algebraic and Euclidean-closure equivalence, plus a root-product description and algorithms for triangle-free classes. D0.5 placed the package at subfield because unrestricted width remains between linear and quadratic orders, exact cross-phase covariance-image equality is unproved, and full-class exhaustion is confined to triangle-free skeletons. The panel's three framing and presentation findings were cleaned in the versioned graph before banking; no Lean formalization was attempted.
tldr: The synchronized-clone family gives, on every \(n\geq5\), the same six-graph full algebraic class and full Euclidean-closure class within \(\mathrm{BAP}(V)\), with exact move width \(n-3\) under either relation; equality of the unclosed cross-phase covariance images is not claimed. Fixed-collider chambers admit a root-factor product and exact count. On triangle-free skeletons each chamber is, within \(\mathrm{BAP}(V)\), both the full exact positive-definite Gaussian distributional class and the full algebraic class, with polynomial-time comparison and canonicalization, exact sampling and counting, polynomial-delay enumeration, and one-pair traversal. Complete-bipartite chambers give explicit full classes of size \(n^{(1-o(1))n}\).
gap: Pairwise algebraic-equivalence tests do not reveal whether a local traversal reaches a whole class. The published five-vertex obstruction fixes the first nontrivial threshold, but no verified growing-width theorem was found in the bounded search.
fill: Prove or refute the synchronized-clone covariance equivalence and exact class characterization, then prove the independent root-factor description and its triangle-free algorithmic consequences.
